checkpoints.description: [1/6] Plan: math3d -> scene graph/cameras -> geometry+OBJ -> OpenGL renderer -> app/demo -> AIKit integration + docs; each milestone ships with tests and a green check

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for a new, performance-first 3D game engine that is AIKit-compatible; a GPU renderer is the only stack with real performance available on this machine (OpenGL 3.3 verified, no Rust/C++ toolchain).
impact_assessment.benefits: GPU-rasterized 3D at interactive frame rates; headless-testable core; zero new installs; each milestone independently verifiable by aikit check.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new package API, no existing consumers; dependency: PyOpenGL/GLFW/numpy versions and GPU driver variance, CI may lack a GL context; concurrency: single-threaded render loop only; state: window/GL resources must be released deterministically.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin deps in requirements.txt; probe OpenGL 3.3 at startup and fail with Why/Fix; keep all rendering tests on a hidden 64x64 context with explicit teardown; no background threads; document GPU requirement.

checkpoints.description: [1/6] Plan: sim core -> procedural terrain -> dungeon generator -> expedition/collision -> vertex-color renderer + seed CLI -> AI harness, docs and gates

impact_assessment.why: Make the extracted world/simulation capabilities the engine core, not demo packs: a seeded expedition loop proves deterministic generation, collision, first-person rendering and AI playability.
impact_assessment.benefits: One reproducible seed drives terrain, dungeon, player state and hash; the sim is renderer-independent and testable headlessly; Aldervale/Crypt-Crawler/Dustline algorithms become reusable engine systems.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: MeshData gains optional vertex colors and Engine.run gains a controls callback; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-threaded fixed-step; state: seeded generation and replay hash must stay stable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Fail-first tests for colors, determinism, collision and mode transitions; ADR for the core contract; renderer integration test and headless screenshot; ports are modular, no monolith pasted.

handoff.evidence: pytest 134 passed, aikit check 6/6, strict check pending clean commit
